definition: the thick end of a handle
description: On the deck of a small fishing boat on a rough grey sea, a young woman with a long braid, a grey fleece and orange waterproof bib trousers braces her feet and fights a fish with a strongly bent rod, the thick end of its handle pushed into a holder at her hip. A big wave crashes over the side and water rushes across the deck. An older man in yellow oilskins comes out of the cabin and holds out a landing net. A bucket of small silver fish, cool boxes and ropes sit on the wet deck.
